name: redeemid/member-preferences
title: Member Preferences
description: A form for the customer fields you let members see or change (RedeemID → Settings → Member preferences), such as the topics they follow. Members read and save their own answers, which are kept on their Shopify customer. Guests can answer too: their answers wait in their browser until they sign in and confirm. A Blockstudio dynamic island: the cached page carries a placeholder and each visitor's fragment fills it in.

attributes.label: Ask guests too (kept in their browser until they sign in)
